target: is_click: the individual kept watching (> ~7 s) a video the production recommender showed

feature_map.user_log_plays_7d: log1p(items the individual consumed (views) in the previous 7 simulated days). Scale: the dataset counts only plays of the 7,583 pool videos, so map by quantile (card feature_quantiles) rather than by raw value
feature_map.user_click_rate: (consumed + 20 m) / (feed exposures + 20) over the individual's whole history before today, m = the card's prior_rate; scale-free
feature_map.item_log_pop_7d: log1p(1000 * views of the item in the previous 7 days / individuals active in those 7 days); per-capita, so independent of population size
feature_map.item_click_rate: (views + 20 m) / (impressions + 20) of the item on the platform before today (audience counters views / impressions); scale-free
feature_map.item_log_age_days: log1p((now - published_at) / 86400); the data cover ages 0-30 days only
feature_map.user_tag_share: (individual's past views in the item's topic + 5 s) / (past views + 5), s = population share of the topic; topic = the item's primary tag or the nearest topic centroid of its embedding
feature_map.user_tag_lift: log(user_tag_share / s): relative interest in the item's topic (0 = average)
feature_map.creator_familiarity: log1p(the individual's past views of this creator's items)
feature_map.item_seen_before: log1p(times the individual was exposed to this item before today)
feature_map.item_played_before: 1 if the individual consumed this item before today, else 0 (repeat consumption)
feature_map.hour_sin: sin(2 pi hour / 24) of the local simulated time
feature_map.hour_cos: cos(2 pi hour / 24) of the local simulated time

selection.rule: argmin validation primary metric (ties to the simpler); keep only if no simple baseline is better on test
selection.reason: selected on validation and confirmed on test: no simple baseline is better on the primary metric

provenance.population: 27,285 anonymised Kuaishou users chosen by the KuaiRand authors (China, 2022); interactions only with the 7,583 videos of the random-exposure pool
provenance.platform: Kuaishou short-video app, single-column featured feed (tab 1)

limits: Evidence: KuaiRand-Pure, 27,285 anonymised Kuaishou users chosen by the KuaiRand authors (China, 2022); interactions only with the 7,583 videos of the random-exposure pool; platform Kuaishou short-video app, single-column featured feed (tab 1); period 2022-04-08 to 2022-05-08. The simulator may use this model for the probability that an individual keeps watching an item its feed shows, as a function of the individual's activity, consume rate, topic affinity and creator familiarity and of the item's popularity, consume rate, age and duration. It may NOT infer: (1) behaviour on platforms other than an autoplay short-video feed (search, long-form video, articles: use news_click for article choice); (2) item ages beyond 30 days (all pool videos were uploaded 2022-04-09..11, so age is confounded with calendar time) or durations outside 6 s - 20 min; (3) responses of other populations or periods (one Chinese app, one month in 2022, a selected user sample, a holiday period 2022-04-30..05-04 inside the data); (4) the effect of social context, prices or advertising, which are not features; (5) quantities on another scale: activity counts cover only pool videos, so map scale-dependent inputs by quantile (feature_quantiles). Topic affinity is measured from one primary tag; with embedding-based affinity the mapping is by quantile, not by value. Repeat consumption is rare in the data (item_played_before is set on 0.007% of rows), so its coefficient is weakly identified.
